Activate A Interact

A corked flask of pale, pearly liquid that swirls slowly on its own beneath a faint haze of vapor, smooth as cream, with a clean scent like rain on warm stone.

You drink this vial to suppress the drawback of one mutagen currently affecting you for 1 minute.

If you have more than one drawback from separate sources, such as from Combine Elixirs or a similar ability, you suppress one of your choice. A mutagen's Drawback entry counts as a single drawback, so suppressing it ends all of its listed penalties and weaknesses for the duration.

Advanced Vial (11th level) When you drink a field vial, you also gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your level for the same duration.
